timeline.title: Research Intern
timeline.description: Engaged in specialized research tasks and deliverables under the direct supervision of Dr. Md. Abdullah-Al-Jubair. Responsible for maintaining strict confidentiality of unpublished research, datasets, and methodologies while dedicating 20 hours weekly to ongoing lab projects.
key_responsibilities: Complete assigned research tasks and deliverables via the lab portal
Maintain strict confidentiality of unpublished research, datasets, and internal communications
Submit weekly progress reports detailing project milestones
Log a minimum of 20 hours per week of dedicated research activity

timeline.title: Research Assistant
timeline.description: Deep learning pipelines for medical image analysis. Extracted and analyzed radiomic features, supported model evaluation and statistical correlation studies. Documented experiments on model reliability, data bias, and clinical applicability.
key_responsibilities: Develop CNN architectures for CT scan analysis
Extract and validate radiomic features for survival prediction
Conduct bias audits and fairness evaluations
Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication

timeline.title: Volunteer Research Assistant

key_responsibilities: Review and synthesize cutting-edge AI safety research
Contribute to framework design for aligned AI systems
Document findings for R&D teams
Support ethical AI governance initiatives

timeline.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
timeline.description: Designed synthetic face generation pipeline with StyleGAN2 and Stable Diffusion XL to address data scarcity. Developed Agentic RAG system for customer support and HR workflow automation.

Implement RAG architectures for enterprise knowledge retrieval
Optimize model inference for production deployment
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on AI product features
achievements: Reduced data collection costs by 70% via synthetic generation
Deployed RAG system serving 500+ daily queries

timeline.title: Kaggle Competition — 1st Runner-up

key_responsibilities: Design multi-model ensemble for robust predictions

Optimize inference pipeline for competition constraints
